common.errorBody: Check your internet and try again.
common.offlineBanner: You’re offline. Packing still works — it will sync when internet is back.

sync.pendingHelp: Packed offline — these will be sent automatically when internet is back.

pwa.installBody: Opens like an app and shows new-order alerts.

queue.emptyBody: New orders will show up here — and as an alert on your phone.
queue.emptyPackedBody: Orders you mark packed wait here for the courier.
queue.emptyPickupBody: Once the courier pickup is booked, the orders and manifest appear here.

a4.hint: Pick orders with a ready label — 4 labels print on each A4 page.

label.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab — tap “Open label”.
label.notReady: The label is still being prepared. Check again in a few minutes.
label.failed: Couldn’t get the label. Try again.
label.downloaded: Label downloaded — open it from Downloads to print.

manifests.title: Pickup manifests
manifests.empty: No manifest yet — it appears after the courier pickup is booked.

pack.title: Pack order {code}
pack.offlineNote: No internet? Mark packed anyway — it syncs automatically.
pack.notFoundBody: It may already be packed, or it belongs to another kitchen.

check.correctBatchHelp: Batch code on the jar matches the code above.
check.weighedHelp: Net weight on the scale is never under the declared weight.
check.sealCheckedHelp: Foam / induction seal in place, cap fully tight.
check.shrinkAppliedHelp: PVC band heat-sealed over the cap and neck.
check.bubbleWrappedHelp: 2–3 layers; shake the box — the jar must not move.
check.labelAppliedHelp: Shipping label, FRAGILE and THIS SIDE UP stickers on the box.

issue.cancelled: {code}: This order was cancelled — do not pack it.
issue.notReady: {code}: Not ready to pack yet — the label is still pending.
issue.notFound: {code}: This order isn’t in your kitchen’s list.
issue.other: {code}: Couldn’t mark packed. Please try again.

batches.title: Batches
batches.noProducts: No products yet — the admin needs to add one first.
batches.noShelfLife: Shelf life not set — ask the admin
batches.costHelp: Meat, oil, spices, jars — everything spent on this batch.
batches.madeOnHelp: Leave as today if made today.
batches.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Extra garlic in this lot
batches.errForbidden: You can only log batches for your own kitchen.
batches.errOffline: No internet — nothing was saved. Try again when online.
batches.errGeneric: Couldn’t save the batch. Try again.
batches.successCodeLabel: Stamp this batch code on every jar
batches.stockEmptyBody: Log a new batch after cooking — it shows up here with stock and expiry.

hisaab.title: Hisaab
hisaab.soonBody: Your settlement statements will appear here — read-only, with an Acknowledge button.

settings.title: Settings
settings.alertsOn: Alerts are on for this phone.
settings.alertsOff: Get a notification the moment a new order comes in.
settings.alertsWhatsapp: Phone alerts aren’t set up on the server yet — new orders come on WhatsApp.
settings.alertsUnsupported: This browser can’t show alerts — new orders come on WhatsApp instead.
settings.alertsIos: On iPhone, alerts work only after you add the app to the Home Screen (steps below).
settings.alertsDenied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser’s site settings, then come back.
settings.alertsNoWorker: Alerts start once the app is opened from the live site (not the test build).
settings.alertsFailed: Couldn’t turn on alerts. Try again.
settings.installReady: Add the Packing Desk to your home screen — it opens like an app.
settings.iosStep2: Tap the Share button (square with an arrow).
settings.iosStep4: Open Pahadi Khatki from the Home Screen and turn on alerts here.
settings.androidStep2: Tap the ⋮ menu → “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
